questions.stem: Which title fits the whole passage best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A Drawing Helps Two Classmates Connect”. Evidence: A new student joins our class during the middle of term. I hope to make friends, but I do not know what to say. During art time, I notice that she is drawing a fox. I ask whether she would like to share her pencils with me. She smiles and gives me a brown one for my own picture. We talk about the animals we like and help put the pencils away. The small conversation makes the next school day feel much easier for both of us.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A Drawing Helps Two Classmates Connect”。原文依据：学期中途，一位新同学来到我们班。我希望交朋友，却不知道说什么。美术活动时，我注意到她正在画狐狸。我问她愿不愿意和我一起用她的彩铅。她微笑着递给我一支棕色彩铅，让我画自己的画。我们聊起喜欢的动物，还一起帮忙收好彩铅。这段小小的交谈让我们两个人第二天上学都轻松多了。

passages.text: Ben accidentally tears a page in a library book at home. He worries that the librarian will be upset when he returns it. For a moment, he wants to tell a lie and say it was already torn. His sister says it is better to tell the librarian about what really happened. Ben takes the book back and explains his mistake honestly. The librarian thanks him for telling her and shows him how to protect damaged pages. Ben feels relieved and handles borrowed books more carefully after that day.
